**The three closures.** In each, the substantive finding was fixed in round 1 or 2 and the other lane now passes outright; what remained was a fresh, smaller citation point. `cor-planar` uses "a tree has *n*−1 edges" uncited — true, standard, and published here as `cor-tree-edge-count`. `lem-colour-focussing` uses pigeonhole uncited — the library proves it as `lem-pigeonhole`. `thm-dirichlet`'s `[L3]` elides hypotheses that step 1.2 verifies explicitly at the point of use. All three are 30-second gaps; all closed with no mutation of any kind.

**The two repairs.** In `ex-row-echelon`, `[L2]` read *"echelon form has the stated pivot conditions"* — the synthetic summary CLAUDE.md forbids — and nothing covered row equivalence at all, though the Example asserts *A* **has** those forms. Both facts now reproduce their definitions verbatim, with the missing dep added (item 0 of the same A page, so no prerequisite moved). In `prop-maximal`, both lanes named the same unlicensed inference: equal *C*-parity ⟹ same region needs the two regions to have *different* parities, which nothing supplied. New step 1.3 derives it from four facts the proof already cited; no dependency edge added.

**Your open question, answered.** `lem-plane-face-handshake-by-girth` is no longer the live defect — round 2's inline handshake identity worked, and DeepSeek's round-3 verdict validates the equality case by name. What replaced it is a *second instance of the same pattern one level up*: `thm-polygonal-jordan-curve` proves in its own steps 1.1/3.1 that the two regions are exactly the even and odd parity classes, and exports only the region count. That is why the consumer had to prove it locally.

I considered parking `prop-maximal` and rejected it on arithmetic, not optimism: its transitive consumer set is 12 further draft items including `thm-five-colour-theorem` and `thm-kuratowski-wagner-planarity-characterisation`. Parking costs 14 items with certainty; repairing cost 14 only if it failed. It didn't — DeepSeek's rejudge says *"The parity argument in step 5.1 is logically sound"*, after its documented single 80k retry.

Six polish items are recorded for step 10 as unlicensed-at-step-8, the load-bearing one being **export the parity characterisation from `thm-polygonal-jordan-curve`**, which would let step 1.3 be deleted in favour of a citation.

All six gates pass (`step8-guard` 2 changed, 2/2 licensed; `proof-contract` 475/475). Receipts closed, snapshot `after-step8c` taken, committed as `30f97484`. Next is the step-9 scope-denial sweep.
